observations: White industrial sewing machine with a red base plate.
Brand 'EMEL' is visible on the side of the machine head in photo 0.
The machine is mounted on a white metal stand with a red foot pedal.
A control panel with a red and green button is visible on the right side of the table.
The machine head is attached to a large motor assembly with a pulley system.
The table surface has a ruler or measuring tape along the edge.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or warehouse environment.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows an Emel brand industrial machine.
The photo cannot confirm the origin of the motor or the machine body.
There is no video or photo of the machine powered on.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty motor.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through all stitch cycles.

risks.risk: The needle or presser foot may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the needle plate.

risks.risk: The table may be warped or unstable.
risks.proof: A photo of the table surface with a straight edge.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching.
Photo of the underside of the needle plate.
Photo of the table surface to check for warping.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
